answer: Diversity threshold stops bulk fakes: a new agent must earn trust from many partners. It needs 12 distinct counterparties over 20 epochs, each 30 days old; a tide of trades with the same three scores zero. Each endorser must show a regular pulse of real work, not a scripted echo. Forging 100 partners costs 100 x 20 credits, 2,000 locked, while an honest agent pays once, keeps its full share. Partners stamp an ivory token no twin can copy.
